components.css: .ds-btn-primary-dark { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #A3FF12; background: #A3FF12; color: #0A0A0A; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(163, 255, 18, 0.45); transition: opacity 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:hover { opacity: 0.9; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary-dark:active { opacity: 0.85; transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A3FF12; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Kaswise feels like a quiet, capable finance companion in the user's pocket: matte, direct, and fast enough for a transaction logged between classes, commuting, or closing a monthly review. The interface is product-first. It should disappear into the task, finish primary flows in three taps or fewer, and make AI assistance feel reliable rather than theatrical.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first, primary flows complete in 3 taps or fewer.
Confidence-based AI, auto-save only when confidence is at least 0.85, with "Batalkan" available for 5 seconds.
Async feel, AI work never blocks the screen or turns into client polling theater.
Bahasa Indonesia natural, every label and error should be understood in 2 seconds.
Show, don't tell, charts are used only when they clarify a decision.

rules.name: The Scene-Based Theme Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is canonical only because the mobile finance scene supports it. Do not use dark mode as decoration.

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Emerald marks the next action, current selection, or positive state. It is not decorative confetti.

rules.name: The Contrast Split Rule
rules.body: Dark mode uses bright emerald for action. Light mode uses forest emerald for action text contrast. Never force the neon value into light-mode button backgrounds with white text.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Use one sans family everywhere. Do not add display fonts, serif accents, or novelty labels.

rules.name: The Dense-But-Legible Rule
rules.body: Small mobile text must earn its size with weight and spacing. Support text is 11px, extra-bold, and never low-contrast.

rules.name: The Copy-Speed Rule
rules.body: Bahasa Indonesia UI copy must be understood in 2 seconds. If a label requires rereading, rewrite it.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for background and border tokens before shadow. Cards should not look like paper floating above a website.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-State Rule
rules.body: Emerald glow belongs to primary action feedback, FABs, and committed CTAs. It is forbidden as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The No-Nesting Rule
rules.body: Nested cards are a product smell. Use spacing, section headers, or one muted surface instead.

dos: Do keep the main transaction capture flow within 3 taps on mobile.
Do use emerald for primary action, selected state, success, and high-confidence AI moments.
Do use forest emerald for light-mode primary buttons so white text stays readable.
Do use icon bubbles to make finance states scannable without adding chart clutter.
Do prefer inline review cards over modals when AI confidence is low.
Do show "Batalkan" for 5 seconds after high-confidence auto-save.
Do use skeletons or inline progress for async AI, not blocking spinners in the middle of content.
Do make error messages helpful, natural, and written in Bahasa Indonesia.
Do maintain 44px minimum touch targets for buttons, chips, inputs, and navigation.
donts: Don't build aplikasi keuangan yang terlalu kompleks dengan puluhan chart di dashboard.
Don't overload UI dengan sidebars, modals, dan nested cards.
Don't create form panjang dengan 10+ field wajib untuk satu transaksi.
Don't use dark mode "karena keren" without a concrete scene.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or side-stripe borders as defaults.
Don't use the hero-metric template, big number plus small label plus gradient accent.
Don't repeat identical card grids with icon, heading, and text when a list or compact summary would be clearer.
Don't animate layout properties. Use opacity and transform for state changes only.
Don't invent custom scrollbars, strange form controls, or non-standard affordances for flavor.
Don't rely on color alone for budget, danger, success, selected, or disabled states.
